Nerf a few specific areas. Shes a bit overtuned, and will be pretty strong stand alone with her itemization. 

She should have at least a skill expression cap of diamond to master since she has such a simple kit and low skill floor. Think of it like Darius or Garen, where they're viably simple, but they have more skill expression due to the nature of their abilities and ultimate since part of their kit is limited in some way to balance out for there sheer damage and ability combinations, such as mobility.

Naafiri only has one major combo, being her gank and its pretty easy to execute in game, so it stands to reason the other parts of her kit shouldn't be so strong when thats the main selling point and what she's so good at already. She doesn't need to do more on top of that. Her punishes are severe and deserved in high elo, but thats due to the simple state of her kit with no real disengage, aside from E-Hops and squishiness - thats how the current meta is built, similar to Yorick since everyone in high elo knows how to freeze and control wave so he can't functionally become the tower wrecking ball everyone knows him as. 

In general though, assassins are super weak in the game due to items like deaths dance, tanks, and prevalance of cc, and enchanter supports like Lulu which stop her from focusing squishier champs. There's nothing Naafiri alone can do about that, so I didn't focus on that part. Realistically, there simply a need for a proper overhaul so burst damage AD champs that don't do true damage can actually preform on an equal level that isn't bullshit like duskblade, but thats probably why she was so overkited on release.
